sources.finding: CharacterClassEscape s includes ECMAScript WhiteSpace and LineTerminator.
WhiteSpace includes TAB VT FF FEFF and Unicode Zs; LineTerminator includes LF CR 2028 2029. Broader Unicode White_Space is intentionally not equivalent.
Rust char::is_whitespace uses Unicode White_Space; char::is_control covers C0 and C1 plus DEL, unlike current public email floor.
